pr_title: Add ability to close playlists within grace period after creation
pr_body:
Closes https://github.com/ppy/osu/issues/30401.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/33ad7c58-b2c0-4c35-81f3-4e6e54d29bb8

Grace period in question is configurable osu-web side via `MULTIPLAYER_ROOM_CLOSE_GRACE_PERIOD_MINUTES` envvar; default is 5 minutes (see https://github.com/ppy/osu-web/pull/11667). Same value is hardcoded in client.

Not sure the lounge context menu is the best place for this necessarily but that was kinda simplest...?

No tests because it felt like adding them would be too expensive for the benefit, but will add on request.
pr_comments: I think we might want to, in addition to the context menu, show a button next to "Start" on the playlist screen for discoverability. What do you think?
Yeah I considered doing that. Not opposed to it in principle, will give it a go.
Yeah, seems good. Although that footer looks horribly bad with this plus the back button, but 🙈 for now.

Just thinking about this one, the number one case where someone is looking to close a playlist is where they made a mistake and wish to make an edit. Do you think it would be good to have an "Edit" button as well (which clones the playlist and places the user back at the create screen)...

This flow feels a bit weird:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/81ec5da1-5715-41ef-b2ea-bb969788f58e

I'd hope for the "Start" button to be disabled at the point of closing, even if we need to shortcut this to happen without a response from the server implying as such.

It seems like the `PlaylistReadyButton` should be updating immediately if `EndDate` is being propagated in, so I guess that's not happening currently?

https://github.com/ppy/osu/blob/dc5337d771ef035ae66911a0de85863661103d65/osu.Game/Screens/OnlinePlay/Playlists/PlaylistsReadyButton.cs#L62-L67

> Just thinking about this one, the number one case where someone is looking to close a playlist is where they made a mistake and wish to make an edit. Do you think it would be good to have an "Edit" button as well (which clones the playlist and places the user back at the create screen)...

You can create a copy of a closed room which would kinda cover this usecase. Not sure I'd want to add anything specially intended for this feature other than that.

> I'd hope for the "Start" button to be disabled at the point of closing, even if we need to shortcut this to happen without a response from the server implying as such.

Fixed in https://github.com/ppy/osu/pull/30793/commits/c93c549b054a7e4ec5935a05e9bb71be807a5182. Bit ad hoc but seems to work well enough.

issue_context.title: Ability to close playlists within time period after creation
issue_context.body:
It's quite easy to make a mistake and want to recreate a playlist. I've had several requests for manual deletion for cases like this. ### Discussed in https://github.com/ppy/osu/discussions/30393
Originally posted by **Hiviexd** October 23, 2024 would be a very appreciated UX improvement imo. in multiple past cases related to spotlights/loved (most recently in [osu!dev]()), we had to request manual edits/deletions to playlists due to mistakes during the creation process (wrong mods, title typo, wrong deadline). so it would be great if users were allowed to close their playlists within 5 minutes after creation, that'd help with solving any potential mistakes while preserving the long-term integrity of playlist leaderboards.
comments: How did you perform the 'deletion' logistically? Did you just set `ends_at` on the room, or did you actually delete rows? I was probably gonna do the former.
Just setting `ends_at` is fine I think. We can "actually" delete it if there's reason provided by users to do so.

review_comments: I hesitantly mentioned this in my other comment, but we could just expose this to the user as "deleting" and not require custom terminology for closing. I think to the user they expect to "delete" a playlist, not "close" it.. but I can swing both ways.
Am neither here or there, fine with either personally.
